id.description: Unique identifier for the API key.

name.description: The display name of the API key.

disabled.description: Whether the API key is disabled.

permissions.description: The permissions granted to this API key.

environment_id.description: The environment this key is scoped to, if applicable.

secret.description: The API key secret, only returned upon creation.

created_at.description: ISO8601 formatted time the API key was created.
